sections.headline: Planning together, on one shared map.
sections.lead: One project in my portfolio is built around collaboration, so this page shows it in depth: RoadTrippin, a trip planner where friends edit the same plan live while they chat or call.

sections.problem: Trip ideas and changes get buried in endless chat histories.
sections.built: A map-based planner that drafts whole trips around a travel profile, with live collaboration on one shared map and an import that turns shared web pages into structured travel information.
sections.result: Used to plan and manage my own trips, with live collaboration.

sections.heading: Interfaces people work with directly
sections.text: Playlist-Canvas turns album covers into a collage you drag, rotate and arrange yourself. Burger Loop explains programming loops with a chef following a burger recipe.

steps.title: Find the sticking point
steps.text: We look at the product, the people using it and one task that matters, starting from a walkthrough.

steps.title: Make the interaction testable
steps.text: I turn the critical flow into a prototype, and we review it before committing to the wider build.

steps.title: Build it into your product
steps.text: I implement the agreed experience with your existing stack where practical, with a handover your team can use.

sections.heading: Who needs to work on the same thing?
sections.text: Tell me who plans, edits or decides together today, and where that work gets lost between tools.
